feature_scope: 356 previously opened calibration frames; descriptive ranges, not fitted physical parameters or independent validation.

policy.authority: User rejected the density of fog and questioned solar density; requested weaker fog and offered actual Wireshark data. User confirmed whole lidar rotates on an external motor at 36 RPM. These are provisional review settings, not calibration or training approval.

limitations: Source shape, flow and radiometry remain assumptions, not empirical fits
10 seeded solenoidal Fourier components plus anisotropic lift and ground damping, not obstacle-aware CFD
3..30 micrometre mineral dust; low-Re Stokes approximation, no coarse dust/resuspension
0.25m extinction grid and 0.125m integration; Qext=2; relative backscatter .12 uncalibrated
0.25m independent detection windows, not pulse convolution or multi-echo
Default 0.20g/s may produce zero dust returns; lower count is not validation
Instantaneous full scan, static actors; within-scan motion distortion omitted
dust.active_generated_points: computed from mass transport and sensor proxy, not particle count
dust.source_model: scene-and-seed varied noncircular ground disturbance; variable length, width, curvature and lift; geometry-following release
dust.default_receiver: independent Poisson photon windows; adaptive threshold
dust.spatial_domain: adaptive 0.25m grid around moving plume; former origin-centered box removed
dust.default_return_warning: Default 0.20g/s may produce zero detected returns. World particles remain viewable; no point quota is forced.

range_error.application: post-detection on all surface and candidate scattering returns
range_error.default_basis: User confirmed the previous simulation defaults on 2026-10-07; not estimated hardware error.
exceptions: sunlight: apparent timing ranges, no additional radial Gaussian layer
weak signal: own signal-dependent range error; no duplicate 60mm layer

scan_geometry.beam_source: already-open public OS-1-128 metadata, official Ouster SDK 0.15.0
scan_geometry.terrain_and_mount_pose: uncalibrated scene-specific assumptions, raycast with original asset meshes

mechanical_wobble.actual_rays: mount rotation times wobble rotation times calibrated beam
mechanical_wobble.optional_reconstruction: actual direction known exactly, same physical returns

scan_geometry.optical_offset_toggle: physical optical origin on/off ablation; not random jitter

geometry_randomization.distribution: independent uniform draws, rounded to UI step .001
geometry_randomization.same_across_noise_categories: true for same scene; explicit auto-selection from indoor to outdoor changes scene
geometry_randomization.terrain_interpretation: standard deviation, explicitly confirmed by user, not maximum height

rain_snow.model: marked Poisson beam-volume intersections with particle size and disk overlap
rain_snow.roof_check_scope: candidate height below 20m; roofs above that are an unresolved approximation
rain_snow.return_selection: uncalibrated photon counts and strongest threshold-crossing candidate
rain_snow.world_display: separate fixed-count moving sample; not one-to-one with observed candidates

fog.model: single scatter attenuation/pulse followed by conditional photon-arrival surrogate

motion.world_view: representative fixed particle samples and motion glyphs; never noise truth
motion.playback: 0.25 simulated seconds per completed frame; not guaranteed real time
motion.surface_collisions: dust mesh segments; precipitation overhead height approximation

solar.angular_distribution: Gaussian review assumption, not empirical fit
solar.range_distribution: uniform apparent ranges, inspired by Velodyne observations in Linnhoff et al. 2022
solar.empirical_scope: OS1-32 had no measured solar false detections in the cited experiment, not a guarantee for all Ouster sensors/conditions
solar.previous_model: v7 radiometry and zero-generation reference retained in historical evidence
solar.default_basis: weak-effect review assumption, not measured frequency; prior .6 kept as comparison button

pattern_review.legacy_circular_source_ui: hidden from active review; code retained for audit

fog.default: weak review preset: 500m visibility and diffuse-return response 10^-3.3
fog.reason: The previous argmax shell is replaced by photon-weighted sampling, not target-sensor calibration. Lower shell concentration alone does not validate the model.
fog.model: independent single-scatter path integral, optical overlap, cos-squared finite pulse and Poisson signal photons
fog.spatial_variation: optional shared low-frequency extinction hypothesis, not a fitted fog field
fog.shell_diagnostic: largest sliding 1m interval; descriptive only, not a realism acceptance threshold
fog.diffuse_return_response_basis: Uncalibrated relative response of broad fog signal before detection. Not actual detection probability or measured optical coefficient.

edge.status: visual review and correction candidate only
edge.method: 13 subrays at depth boundaries; weighted Gaussian pulse sum and global-seeded peak search
edge.marking: yellow for center-ray range change above .05m; not removal truth
limits: neighbor-based candidate gate can miss thin structures

explicit_exclusions.reason: Cause and label accuracy unverified; copying its shape may teach deletion of real structures.
Unfounded locations and frequency create isolated-point shortcuts or ambiguous labels; only a separately named stress test could use them.
Near-range shell and no sensor calibration. v10 is a distinct uncalibrated candidate, not an approved replacement.
Real surface information can be uncertain or biased; blanket removal harms boundaries and small objects.
Timing, relative illumination and proprietary receiver behavior not measured.

external_rotation.analysis_requirement: sensor per-column timestamps and time-aligned motor angle/axis/mount transform; clock mapping matters

spatial_density_diagnostic.scope: Educational comparison only: uniform Cartesian volume, uniform apparent range, and a toy distance selection applied to the same volume sample

confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.basis: User confirmed the previously agreed review parameters; not measured sensor calibration or training authorization.
confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.formula: sigma(r)=sqrt(0.06^2+(0*r)^2); Gaussian error along the beam after return selection
confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.terrain_bound_meaning: standard deviation, not an absolute height limit
confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.seed_scope: scene ID and user seed, unchanged by weather category or time
confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.world_background: exact detected surface XYZ shared with lidar view, including range error and uncompensated angular reconstruction
confirmed_observation_defaults_v16.world_particles: physical transport illustrations, not sensor observations; no radial measurement error added to these particle positions
exceptions: Sun phantom ranges keep their dedicated timing-range model
Weak-signal mode uses its own signal-dependent range error without an extra 60mm layer
Edge mixing keeps its pulse-mixing model

source_scope: All sources identified in this project so far; not a claim of exhaustive internet acquisition. Access-blocked and request-only sources remain explicitly unacquired.

weather_review_v4.indoor_selection: rain/snow auto-select corresponding construction variant when previous scene is indoors; indoor choices disabled in precipitation modes
weather_review_v4.unlabeled_real_context: keep visible when synthetic target-only display is selected

asset_expansion_v18.scope: 9 outdoor DEMO examples; fixed mesh layout per example, not regenerated by weather seed

terrainCm.sample_scope: scene+seed; terrain standard deviation, not maximum height

wobblePhase.note: Circular phase; ordinary mean/std is not a useful summary

parameter_distributions_v18.weather_factor_distribution: uniform, half-width sqrt(3)*std; actual relative std=5%, limits ±8.6603% before UI-domain clipping
parameter_distributions_v18.seed_contract: same scene, seed, settings and time reproduce the result; new seed resamples; redraw/tab/camera does not

spatial_contract.rain: beam-volume Poisson sampling; independent observed returns by seed and time; world particles move coherently but are illustrative
spatial_contract.snow: same spatial sampling rules as rain, distinct size and settling assumptions
spatial_contract.fog: photon-weighted return location by seed; no advected fog field or time animation
spatial_contract.dust: scene+seed source and flow profile; coherent motion; emitter position remains a user control
spatial_contract.sun: seeded false ranges in configured solar direction; azimuth/elevation remain user controls

parameter_distributions_v18.asset_contract: 24 fixed DEMO layouts, 3 per family; weather seed does not move buildings, trucks or props
